definitions.explanation: A face that is round rather than long or angular; often felt to look young, gentle or cute.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{丸顔|まるがお}だ。
{丸顔|まるがお}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{優|やさ}しそうな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧。
examples.english: A kind-looking person with a round face.

examples.japanese: {丸顔|まるがお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧⟦{髪型|かみがた}→髪型：14646_kamigata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{美容師|びようし}→美容師：15428_biyoushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I asked the hairdresser about hairstyles that suit a round face.
